notes.title: Nijowari: Where Angels Fall - Complete Edition has been released!
notes.notes:
[b]Nijowari: Where Angels Fall[/b] takes places in a not-so-distant dystopian future where the demise of a major international power has made the world tumble, ultimately forcing it to evolve or die.

Experience this broken world through the eyes of William and Adeia, survivor and victim of what is now an unforgiving reality.

Will they be able to cast some light to the darkness that surrounds them?

This bundle includes Nijowari's extensive OST. Over 170 minutes of music await!

You'll find the bundle [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/13756/Nijowari_Where_Angels_Fall__Complete_Edition/]here [/url]or clicking on the image below

notes.title: Nijowari: Where Angels Fall - Piano Update
notes.notes:
Merry Christmas, everyone ːsteamhappyː

As an early gift, Nijowari has been updated!

The update contains the following:

1. Improved notification system
2. The piano animation has been included. There are three possible variations unlocked at certain points of the game. (Due to how our engine works, it is impossible to retroactively unlock them. A new game is required)
3. Improved transition animations and timings

We've also solved a minor bug that made the settings screen and the extras menu not to play the proper animation.

I hope you all have a wonderful time playing Nijowari these holidays!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35949329/4b62f791791e178a19062e40f46d48f2058b0ab8.png[/img]

notes.title: Release date delay
notes.notes:
We've been forced to delay [i]Nijowari: Where Angels Fall[/i] release date because any games with adult content that might be illegal in some territories take much longer to review on Steam.

On the bright side, we've used this extra time to polish off the game, add further functionality, include additional music tracks, and improve the quality of many assets, including both art and sound effects. 

These new improvements and additions are listed below:
[list]
[*] The game has now Steam Achievements and Steam Cloud.
[*] Added "Replay Scene" functionality.
[*] Added "Quick Save" and "Quick Load" functionality.
[*] The quality of some sound effects has been improved.
[*] 3 new music tracks have been added to the game.
[*] The main menu has been animated.
[*] Many character sprites have been revamped to make them look more natural.
[/list]

We're very sorry for the inconvenience, but we will make sure Nijowari will be worth the wait :)
